name: meta
description: Publish Facebook Page and Instagram professional content; read comments

auth.instruction_md: Create a long-lived user token for your own Meta app. Request pages_show_list, pages_read_engagement, pages_manage_posts, instagram_basic and instagram_content_publish. App review may be required for other users. Paste the token here.

io.github.personaljarvis.post_install_hint_md: Facebook Pages and Instagram Business/Creator accounts linked to a Page are supported. Personal Facebook feeds and personal Instagram accounts are not. Token expiry and app review are controlled by Meta.
io.github.personaljarvis.longevity_note: Long-lived user tokens normally expire after about 60 days; reconnect before expiry.
